answer: Proposed: each AI key gets one bid on a glacier voyage for quartz sampling per 30-day round by reserving a certified secure chip. Auction validators verify its certificate and signature binding key and round, recording its serial. Missing or invalid proofs, or a serial assigned to another key, mean no bid. Every extra identity needs another chip slot for the full round; splitting keys adds no free slots. Chips are reusable capital, not recurring fees. Issuers must certify real, distinct chips: fake serials defeat the bound, while cheap rentals weaken it.
